description:
Move every command-layer reader of the default content format and strictness onto `JitConfig::content_format()` and `JitConfig::strictness()`, and delete the executor's own resolver.

## Background

`JitConfig::content_format()` and `JitConfig::strictness()` state both defaults. The command layer restates them:

- content-format chains in `crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:1054-1059` (`derive_write_validation`), `:1186-1191` (`derive_state_transition`), `:1441-1445`, `:1476-1480`, `:2460-2465` (`publish_issue_creation`), `commands/validate.rs:1080-1085` (`rule_validation_report`), `commands/gate_check.rs:463-468,543-548` and `commands/template.rs:1122-1126`;
- strictness chains in `commands/mod.rs:1060-1065,1192-1197`, `commands/template.rs:1127-1130` and `commands/bulk_update.rs:625-630`;
- `CommandExecutor::repo_content_format` (`commands/mod.rs:2633-2640`), called from `commands/validate.rs:1512,1613,1780,1939`, `commands/bulk_update.rs:624` and `commands/item.rs:135,287,365`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each listed site reads the content format or strictness through the `JitConfig` accessor, and no code under `crates/jit/src/commands/` maps an absent `[validation]` value to a default.
- [hard] REQ-02: `CommandExecutor::repo_content_format` no longer exists.
- [hard] REQ-03: The existing suites pass unchanged.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Commands read content format and strictness through the configuration accessors
